summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for pointer coordinate extraction using d3.pointer()/d3.pointers() APIs. It has unique semantic identity (coordinate extraction from DOM events) separate from peer candidates which handle event listener management, custom event dispatch, and zoom event registration. No existing skill matches this capability. Peer candidates are complementary event-handling skills at same granularity but different methods. Existing skills are unrelated (async callbacks, IDF computation). Support evidence confirms d3.pointer API relevance.
